text:
alex: Quick post-call note: vendor sprint changed dates. H100 delivery now mid-August window; H200 patch may require image pinning; Gaudi kernel API bump will force SI rebuilds. Need coordinated announcement plan for marketplace + partners.
nina: marketplace ask: we need final image hash + driver info 12 calendar days before any public listing. Also request: sign-off list from legal/compliance for firmware deviations.
tom: perf note: lab shows H100 microcode causing jitter on long contexts. We saw token-level stalls at 2% on 4k sequences. Repro: `python perf_run.py --model h100-rtx --seq 4096 --iter 1000`.
emily: ops suggestion: publish a "staggered announce" plan: public PR only after vendor finalizes GA; meantime provide partner-only early access starting 2024-07-28. That gives SIs a week to rebuild.
partner-bot: Vendor feed: H100 estimated GA 2024-08-12; H200 firmware rollback under discussion; MI300 APAC trial unchanged; Gaudi ABI bump scheduled 2024-07-20. (link: https://vendor.example/feed/3611)
alex: proposed actions:
- partner-only early access window: 2024-07-28 -> 2024-08-05 (Nina)
- integrator rebuild kickoff for Gaudi: 2024-07-21 (Tom)
- marketplace image pin-with-hash if H200 rollback happens (Emily)
- fallback path mapping: map H100->b200-quant for latency-critical routes (Alex/Tom)
nina: note on comms: marketing needs 9 calendar days for co-announcement copy and embargo prep. We'll aim for partner-only notice first.
tom: SI ops: rebuild plan will include container hash, a smoke test suite, and perf sanity. Expect 48-72h turnaround if we prioritize.
emily: infra: can spin up temporary B200 capacity in Dedicated to absorb any H100 rollout delays. Need lead time ~36h to reprovision.
alex: risks to log: EU localized testing for private deployments may add 5 business days. We'll flag it in the partner timeline doc.
partner-bot: Reminder: vendor security advisory portal updated 2024-07-10. Check CVE feed before final marketplace publish.
nina: ok, I'll draft the partner-only schedule and the marketplace gating checklist and share in drive.
tom: will ping integrator leads to reserve rebuild lanes.
emily: opening infra ticket INF-9001 for temporary capacity plan.
alex: thanks all. We'll reconvene once vendor confirms GA date. End.
